products.name: Presentations.AI
products.note: Text-to-presentation AI; automated layouts; brand templates; content governance

profile_text.body:
Presentations.AI is an AI presentation platform founded in 2018 by Sumanth Raghavendra, Ravi Kasthuri, and Saravanan Govindaraj, and built by a 30-person team. The company is headquartered in Singapore and describes itself as having two decades of enterprise software experience behind it. Its platform takes topics, documents, PDFs, Word files, or URLs as input and generates structured, designed slide decks, which can be exported as native .pptx files or to Google Slides. The site reports the platform is trusted by 12 million teams.

The core product, also called Presentations.AI, sits in the slides and presentations category and combines automated layout selection, brand template application, and content generation. The site describes the tool as a "ChatGPT for presentations," noting that the AI adjusts its structure depending on the stated purpose of a deck, whether an investor pitch, a sales deck, or a board presentation. Features include a slide-by-slide creator for manual control, a ChatGPT integration that converts existing prompts or conversations into decks, real-time collaboration, and API-based generation for scale. The company positions itself against competitors such as Gamma, Canva, and Microsoft Copilot, arguing it is the only platform combining deck creation, data-connected refresh, and API-based generation in a single product.

The held facts confirm Presentations.AI has a profile page on theworldofai.org, verified as of August 30, 2026, with no recorded litigation or MCP server presence in the registry.
